name: EH3D-SUITE-LAUNCHER
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.1: a library and a command line that find the programs of the suite by their eh3d.project.json manifests, start a program and start it again a limited number of times when it fails, keep the list of recent projects and read and write the project file (.eh3dproj: name, files with kind and SHA-256, work zero). No window yet, no discovery of machines on the network, and nothing here has run on a machine.
